156 sites have no urban centre within 25 km
Monarch Hill Landfill (FL) has 4.8 years and 5.5 million people within 25 km. Of the 80 sites under five years, 22 do not collect their gas either.
No index, no weighting. A composite would rank a site that is extreme on one axis and ordinary on the other below one that is mediocre on both, which is the opposite of triage.
Population is counted from urban-area centroids, so it undercounts a landfill on the edge of a large city. Read the bottom row as "no urban centre nearby", not as "nobody there".
